name: Browser_LoadPage_Http

name: Browser_LoadPage_Connect

name: Browser_LoadPage_Request
evidence: Connected: clears SRAM bank3 $B000 ($1000 bytes), strips a URL fragment (4C:46A6), C26D=5 / timer B reset, C2C7..C2C9 = $B000 bank 3, bc=$0FFC and Http_StartGet (54:4288); then Browser_LoadPage_WaitReply

name: Browser_LoadPage_WaitReply

name: Url_StripFragment
evidence: Frame service, then scans $C380 for '#' ($23) or NUL and writes a NUL there: cuts the URL fragment before the request; 3 internal callers, 11 scenarios

name: CommProgress_Init
evidence: A=progress kind: stores it in hRam_FFB0 and jumps by wRam_C2C3 (0 -> 70:4000, 1 -> 68:7405) which store the kind and clear the step state; 4 callers here, 11 scenarios

name: CommProgress_Step
evidence: A=0: run one frame of the communication progress screen, A=1: run its finish step (loops until it returns 0); dispatches by wRam_C2C3 (0 -> 70:4023, 1 -> 68:7413); returns the state byte; 24 internal callers

name: Comm_Disconnect

name: Comm_EndOffline

name: Comm_DisconnectWithProgress

name: Browser_FetchInlineImages
evidence: Walks the image URL list left by Html_ScanPage (WRAM bank 4 $DE00), resolves each URL (HtmlUrl_Resolve/NormalizePath), appends each reply to the resource list at SRAM bank3 $B000 (cursor C2C7..C9) via Http_StartGet/Poll; 5 scenarios

name: Browser_HistoryReset
evidence: SRAM bank1: A9FE=A9FF=0 and $AA00..$AFFF ($600 bytes) zeroed = empty 6-entry URL history; called by Browser_LoadAndDispatch (13 scenarios)

name: Browser_HistoryPush
evidence: Stores the URL at $D500 (WRAM bank 6, $100 bytes) in the history ring: dest $AA00+$100*[A9FE] (SRAM bank1), A9FE=(A9FE+1) mod 6, A9FF=min(A9FF+1,6); 4B81 is the entry with HL/A given (5 scenarios)

name: Browser_HistoryPop
evidence: DE=dest (bank A): zeroes [DE]; if A9FF!=0: A9FF--, A9FE=(A9FE-1) mod 6 and copies that $100-byte entry to DE; returns A=[DE] (0 = history empty); 7 callers in 4E:4B8C..4E:4E6E (3 scenarios)

name: Sram_CopyLongBlock
evidence: HL=src (bank hRam_FFB0), DE=dst (bank hRam_FFB1), BC=length, copied in chunks of up to $200 bytes staged through $C380; an address that passes $C000 wraps to $A000 and its bank number is incremented; used by PageCache_Push/Pop

name: Browser_ClearCaches
evidence: Frame service; SRAM bank1 A9FC=A9FD=0; SRAM banks 2 and 3 wiped ($2000 bytes each): empties the 3-slot page cache; first call of Browser_LoadAndDispatch, 13 scenarios

name: PageCache_Push
evidence: Copies the current page ($1000 bytes at SRAM bank3 $B000) to the slot given by Table_4C_4CEA[A9FC] (bank 2/3, $A000/$B000), A9FC=(A9FC+1) mod 3, A9FD=min(A9FD+1,3); 5 scenarios

name: Table_PageCache_Slots
evidence: 4 triples (address lo, hi, SRAM bank) = $A000/2, $B000/2, $A000/3, $B000/3; only the first 3 are used (index A9FC counts mod 3); read by PageCache_Push/Pop

name: PageCache_Pop
evidence: BC=size DE=dst A=bank: if A9FD!=0: A9FD--, A9FC=(A9FC-1) mod 3, clears the destination and copies that slot back (4C:4C03), also copies $C380 to $D500; returns A=$FF when a page was restored, 0 when empty; 6 callers in 4E, 3 scenarios

name: Function_4C_4D6F
evidence: Discards the newest page-cache slot and the newest history entry without copying (A9FD--, A9FC-- mod 3; A9FF--, A9FE-- mod 6); one caller (4E:4C78); not executed

name: Browser_MapErrorToResult
evidence: A=SDK error code: codes below $10 or from $34 up -> $84; $26 with C2C3=1 -> $84; otherwise Table_4C_4DD6[code-$10] ($03 for $24 and $30-$33, $05 for $26); the caller stores result&$7F in C2CA; executed in 6 scenarios

name: Table_Browser_ErrorResult
